items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: Interviewer mentions Lennon came to the record date; Interviewee responds only about Basie not remembering.

ctx.x: “Basie’s Beatle Bag,” and something else, I can’t remember because we never really played the tunes after we did the album. But I remember one of the, I can’t remember whether it was Lennon or somebody else came to the record date while we were doing it. But they had never forgotten that Basie had come in and said that they sounded good.
